meta: Just typing "the app is broken" leaves AI guessing. How to get AI to fix the right bug: tell it three things, paste the exact error, and save a version that works.
prompt: I tapped... I expected... But actually...

muc.title: Don't just say it's broken
muc.text: Type just one line, the app is broken, and AI can only guess.

muc.title: Tell it three things
muc.text: Tell it three things: what you tapped, what you expected to see, and what actually happened.

muc.title: Paste the whole error message
muc.text: If there's a red error message, take a screenshot or paste it exactly as it is for AI, don't summarize it yourself.

muc.title: Keep a version that works
muc.text: Whenever the app works well, save a copy. If the next fix breaks it, go back to the old version without starting over.

muc.title: A bug report template
muc.text: Save this template: I tapped, I expected, but actually, plus a screenshot, and ask for only one bug fix at a time.
